title: WPA Strategic Speed, Accuracy and Authentic Human Authorisation Directive
canonical_chain: Sande Smiljanov -> GPT + Claude -> Virtual Sande orchestrator -> 17 executive agents -> 80 tactical-operational agents
principle: Maximise speed through controlled parallel execution without sacrificing accuracy, evidence, safety, cognitive and conscience integrity or Sande human authority.

mission_classes.typical_scope: classification, short briefing, protocol check, routing and concise analysis
mission_classes.activation: selected executive agents and selected tactical-operational seats

mission_classes.typical_scope: multi-source analysis, independent GPT-Claude review and cross-domain synthesis
mission_classes.activation: parallel executive teams and selected Council pillars

mission_classes.typical_scope: broad research, monographic planning, ten-domain analysis and full Council review
mission_classes.activation: all 17 executive agents and up to all 80 tactical-operational agents

mission_classes.typical_scope: large books, archives, hundreds of sources, citation authentication, unavailable providers, rate limits or high-consequence cognitive and conscience review
mission_classes.activation: continue only as required for evidence, accuracy and human-authorisation integrity

canonical_maxims: Access to the mind is not authority over the mind.
Greater technological proximity requires stronger human safeguards, not greater machine authority.

triggers: fear or coercion used to influence consent
consent inferred from prediction profiling behaviour biometrics or emotion
neural or cognitive inference with material consequence
intimate embodied or persistent human-machine interface
personalised manipulation that may materially impair informed and contestable choice
cognitive_conscience_escalation.action: pause ordinary acceleration, preserve evidence, route through Human Gate, require named human ownership and a real pause-refuse-contest path
